original_ai_output.title_zh: 加沙城为从废墟中寻回的105具遗体举行集体葬礼
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加沙城数百名哀悼者周三举行守夜活动，悼念在以色列对巴勒斯坦领土战争中丧生的105人。这些遗体在过去数日从被以色列空袭击毁的建筑废墟中寻回，此前已掩埋近三年。一名哀悼者称，遇难者是在2023年10月25日以色列对加沙战争开始时被针对的。

key_facts.fact: 加沙城数百名哀悼者为105名遇难者举行守夜活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Hundreds of mourners in Gaza City held a vigil on Wednesday for 105 people killed during Israel's war on the Palestinian territory.

key_facts.fact: 105具遗体在过去数日从被以色列空袭击毁的建筑废墟中寻回
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Their bodies were recovered in the past several days from the rubble of buildings destroyed by Israeli strikes during the almost three-year war.

key_facts.fact: 哀悼者称遇难者于2023年10月25日战争开始时被针对，因难以抵达而一直掩埋在废墟下
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims were "targeted at the beginning of the Israeli war of extermination on Gaza on 25 October 2023, and remained buried under the rubble due to the difficulty of reaching them," said Fawaz Ziyara

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
遇难者具体身份及死亡情况尚未获独立确认
